title: ESSAY 7: UPI — How India Rewrote the Rules of Global Payments

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: UPI was developed by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) and regulated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).
It leverages the Immediate Payment Service (IMPS) backend to enable instant real-time money transfers between bank accounts.
By utilizing Virtual Payment Addresses (VPA), UPI eliminates the need to share sensitive banking details like account numbers and IFSC codes.
It has powered financial inclusion in India by drastically lowering transaction costs and enabling micro-payments.
India is expanding UPI globally through cross-border linkage projects with countries like Singapore, UAE, France, Nepal, and Bhutan.

blocks.content: UPI has transformed India's financial landscape from cash-dominated to a world leader in real-time digital payments.

items: NPCI is an umbrella organization created under the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007, jointly by RBI and Indian Banks' Association (IBA).
UPI enforces 2-factor authentication using a single-click PIN verification framework mandated by the RBI.
Exams frequently test differences between UPI, NEFT, RTGS, and IMPS regarding settlement mechanics and transaction limits.
